{{Quote|I'm with the Republic Strategic Information Service. Key word is information&mdash;if you talk, I let you go.|[[Theron Shan]], SIS agent|<ref name="TORTLS1">[[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 1|''The Old Republic — The Lost Suns'' 1]]</ref>}}
The '''Republic Strategic Information Service''', most commonly known simply as the '''Strategic Information Service (SIS)''' or '''Republic Intelligence''', was the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] domestic and foreign intelligence agency during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the following [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|period of political unrest]]. Although the agency existed prior to the Great War's [[Assault on the Tingel Arm region|initiation]] in [[3681 BBY]], as a monitoring and decryption arm of the [[Senate Library]], the rapid expansion of the conflict prompted the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] to shift the group from a small-scale decryption agency to a full-fledged information and [[Spy/Legends|espionage]] bureau.

The SIS was much younger, smaller, and was stretched thinner than its [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|intelligence counterpart]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], yet it served efficiently during the Great War and the subsequent Cold War. In [[3643 BBY]], under the [[Director of Republic Strategic Information Service|direction]] of [[Marcus Trant]], [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Theron Shan]] undertook a [[Mission to the Vesla system|mission]] to the [[Vesla system/Legends|Vesla system]] to find and gain information about the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire from [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ngani Zho]]. In the process, Shan discovered the Empire's secret [[Warship/Legends|warship]] builder, the [[Sun Razer]], designed by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Mekhis]]. Shan destroyed the Sun Razer and the resulting [[Politics/Legends|political]] fallout pushed the Republic and Empire ever closer to a renewed, full out war. The agency was also called in to investigate the theft of secret plans for the Republic's [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], the [[Planet Prison]]. Through the investigation, the plans were recovered and the designer of the superweapon, [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]], was revealed to be a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. With this, other secret Republic research such as the [[Power Guard Enhancement System|Power Guard Project]] were put at risk and the SIS and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] moved to secure the projects from Sith control.

==Overview==
{{Quote|But the galaxy has changed, and someone with flexibility has to protect the Republic.|SIS Director Marcus Trant|<ref name="TORTLS1" />}}
[[File:RSISdirectoroffice.png|thumb|left|280px|The SIS Director's office in the Heorem Complex.]]
The Republic Strategic Information Service was an [[Spy/Legends|espionage]] agency of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Though it was smaller and younger and managed a smaller network of spies and [[Information broker/Legends|informants]] than its [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|intelligence counterpart]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] it was still deemed to be an effective intelligence service. Serving as an agency with the [[Senate Library]] before the [[Great Galactic War]], the SIS was charged by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] with monitoring and decryption duties. With the outbreak of war, the agency was responsible for providing intelligence to the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. By the end of the war and the start of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], its duties included the management of networks, counter-intelligence, foreign intelligence, military intelligence, and assisting local [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agencies]].<ref name="SWTORSIScodex" />

The SIS was headquartered in the [[Heorem Complex]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="TORFatal" /> and was led by the [[Director of Republic Strategic Information Service|Director of SIS]] who would have several [[Agent/Legends|agents]] on special assignments answer directly to him.<ref name="TORency" /> Under the Director were regional operational directors such as the [[Director of Core World Operations]]<ref name="dossiereckard">{{TORcite|SIS Dossier: Doctor Eckard Lokin}}</ref> and the [[Director of Mid Rim Operations]].<ref name="TORency" /> Below the regional Directors there were [[Station chief]]s, who oversaw operations within a [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="TORmsg Ki Sazen">{{TORcite|type=message|FW: Ki Sazen's Cult|Ardun Kothe}}</ref> Planetary operations were headed by [[Bureau Chief]]s<ref name="TORency" /> who supervised [[Special Agent/Legends|Special Agents]] and regular agents.<ref name="SWTORsfg">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Search for Agent Galen|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref> Other ranks within the SIS included Senior Agent<ref name="TORZane">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|New Circumstances|Hoth}}</ref>, as well as various military ranks such as [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]]<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|The Emperor's Vaults}}</ref>, [[Captain/Legends|captain]]<ref name="SWTOR">{{TORcite|type=general|Freeze Out The Empire|Hoth}}</ref> or [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]].<ref name="TORArmageddon">{{TORcite|type=class|Agent|Armageddon|Corelia}}</ref>

All SIS agents were trained to speak [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]].<ref name="Annihilation" />

==History==
===Early operations===
{{Quote|I was there when the war started, back when the Strategic Information Service was a monitoring and decryption arm of the Senate Library. Now we're, what&mdash;the thirtieth, fortieth attempt at a Republic espionage agency?''"<br />"''Depends whose conspiracy theories you believe.|Director Marcus Trant and Theron Shan|<ref name="TORTLS1" />}}
[[File:RSISspeeder.png|thumb|right|275px|Theron Shan with the Director and two bodyguards]]
The SIS was founded prior to the start of the Great Galactic War by the Galactic Senate as an intelligence agency with monitoring and decryption duties for the Senate Library.<ref name="TORTLS1" /> Before that, [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] had been in operation during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]<ref name="KoS">[[Knights of the Old Republic 22|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 22]]</ref> then later disbanded,<ref name="TORTLS1" /> yet the SIS continued to be known as Republic Intelligence.<ref name="Blood Money">{{TORcite|type=heroic|Blood Money|Coruscant}}</ref> Years before the war, Republic [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] discovered an ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[The Tomb|prison complex]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] and, during several secret sessions, the SIS decided to convert the complex into a new [[Prison/Legends|detention facility]], to be used to house dangerous prisoners whose [[Death/Legends|execution]] was not possible or simply imbcal.<ref name="holoBel">{{Holonet|planets|belsavis|Belsavis}}</ref>

With the emergence of the Sith Empire and the outbreak of war, the Senate removed the agency from the Senate Library and expanded its duties. Due to its small size and relative newness, the SIS lacked the large network or bureaucracy that its [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] counterpart possessed. This became both an advantage and a disadvantage. The SIS had little oversight systems to worry about yet it remained within its legal boundaries even as it sought loopholes around it and ethical boundaries as evident when imprisoning the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] hero [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Shange]].<ref name="Freed1">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=6334925#edit6334925|text=Developer Alexander Freed on the ''SWTOR'' community forums}}</ref> However, the agency had a hard time penetrating the Sith Empire. Following its emergence as an intelligence bureau, conspiracy theorists claimed the SIS was the Republic's thirtieth or fortieth attempt at an espionage agency, a theory not far from the truth.<ref name="TORTLS1" />

In [[3661 BBY]] on Belsavis, the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] hero [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Shange]] opposed the Cathar's joining the Republic. Needing the Prince quieted, SIS operatives abducted him and his followers and took him to the Belsavis prison and placed them in stasis.<ref name="oncefuture">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Once and Future|Belsavis}}</ref> During several confrontations with the Empire, Republic warships went missing with their crew overcome by some [[Mind trick/Legends#Force fear|unknown terror]]. SIS listing posts in the Outer Rim were able to intercept coded messages referring to these incidents and to a group of Sith Lords known as the [[Dread Masters]]. With the information in hand, Jedi Knight [[Jaric Kaedan]] and a team of Republic Special Forces troopers were able to infiltrate the Imperial dreadnaught and capture the Sith Lords. The Masters were then taken for internment to The Tomb prison complex on Belsavis.<ref name="DuralJournal">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref>

During [[Hylo Visz]]'s attack on the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[blockade of the Hydian Way]], the SIS was informed of the battle and scrambled [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to aid the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] in her mission to break the blockade for the Republic. The battle was a victory for Visz and the Republic, and the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] was once again open for the transportation of goods and military wares. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]], the [[Lore Keeper|keeper]] of the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]], mentioned this action by the SIS in his [[Galactic Timeline (in-universe)|holodocumentary]]<ref name="Timeline2">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 2: The Mandalorian Blockade is Broken|int=Timeline 2: The Mandalorian Blockade is Broken}}</ref> and his [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural|journal]].<ref name="DuralJournal" />

===Cold War===
{{Quote|But we don't have a clue what goes on inside the Empire&ndash;and we haven't since the Treaty of Coruscant. We follow ''every lead'' we've got.|Director Marcus Trant|<ref name="TORTLS1" />}}
By [[3643 BBY]], despite the agency's relative efficiency during the war, it held little knowledge of the inner workings of Imperial Intelligence.<ref name="TORTLS1" /> In [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], the SIS was able to establish a spy network.<ref name="AMofSWTOR">''[[The Art and Making of Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> At the same time, however, an SIS station on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] was shut down and rumors of Imperial mobilization in that area were increasing.<ref name="TORTLS2">[[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 2|''The Old Republic — The Lost Suns'' 2]]</ref> Consequently every lead was vital. When [[Ngani Zho]], a great [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] warrior who had disappeared after the war, was spotted near the Imperial border, the SIS took immediate interest. Discovering that Zho had claimed to have returned from the [[Vesla system/Legends|Vesla system]], a "[[Black Sector]]" ceded to the Empire as part of the treaty, the SIS sent several agents to investigate hoping to gain knowledge from Zho's time behind enemy lines. However, none of the SIS agents returned. In the aftermath of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], the SIS became spread thin. The Director was under pressure not only to find information on the Sith but he also had a bounty placed on his head and [[Elin Garza|his ex-wife]] was under investigation by the Senate. Needing new leads into Imperial Intelligence, the SIS director decided to send [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Theron Shan]] to find Zho and discover his knowledge.<ref name="TORTLS1" />

[[File:Theronspying.png|thumb|left|200px|Agent Shan observing a target]]
After several weeks, Shan, along with a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] criminal named [[Teff'ith]] that Shan had picked up on Coruscant, was able to track down the missing Jedi Master Zho on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. The three were followed and attacked by [[Darth Mekhis' Sith Knights|Sith Knights]] under the control of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Mekhis]]. They managed to defeat the Knights and escape Taris. Shan then questioned Master Zho on his experiences in the Vesla system. Except for knowing that the system was under the control of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Mekhis and that she was constructing horrible weapons, the old Jedi was not able to remember much of what happened. He was insistent though that Darth Mekhis must be stopped. Shan consulted with the SIS Director and learned that the Sith Empire had shut down an SIS station on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and there were rumors that the [[Imperial Guard]] was mobilized. Feeling the need to press their advantage then, the SIS Director authorized Shan to investigate the activity within the Vesla system.<ref name="TORTLS2" />

After securing clearances and [[Star map/Legends|navigation charts]] at [[Port Nowhere]], Shan and his team [[Mission to the Vesla system|entered the Vesla system]] and set up an observation post with telescopes and a [[spy ray]] developed by SIS scientist [[Nasan Godera|Dr. Nasan Godera]]. Several days later the planet's rotation allowed Shan to view the other planets in the system. He was able to see Darth Mekhis's [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] that was fueled by the [[Sun Razer]], which used the energy of the system's sun to create a new and experimental class of [[Warship/Legends|warship]] called the [[Javelin Dreadnought]]. The warship was capable of using its weapons to flash irradiate a planet's surface from space, wiping out all life below within a three kilometer radius. Shan recorded the information and attempted to leave the system with his companions; however, they were spotted and captured by the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] [[Imperial dreadnaught|dreadnaught]] ''[[Valor Prevails]]'' under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Eisek]].<ref name="TORTLS3">[[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 3|''The Old Republic — The Lost Suns'' 3]]</ref>

====Taking action====
{{Quote|This is a knife right in the guts of the Treaty. You may've started a war, Theron.''"<br />"''We couldn't sit back and watch forever.''"<br />"''Maybe not.|Director Marcus Trant and Theron Shan|<ref name="TORTLS5">[[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 5|''The Old Republic — The Lost Suns'' 5]]</ref>}}
[[File:Shanshoots.png|thumb|right|250px|Agent Shan shoots Darth Mekhis]]
When they were captured, Shan was taken on a tour of the facilities by Captain Eisek while Master Zho was placed under interrogation. During this, Zho revealed his adventures and how he had slipped into the [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] labor force the Empire was using to build the Sun Razer so that Zho could investigate the Vesla system. After the tour, Shan was taken to the same room as Zho and placed in restraints. Darth Mekhis then ordered the execution of Zho but before that could be carried out, Shan was able to free them both from the restraints. They then met up with Teff'ith to plan their next move. Instead of attempting to leave again and report to the SIS, Shan decided to destroy the Sun Razer.<ref name="TORTLS4">[[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 4|''The Old Republic — The Lost Suns'' 4]]</ref>

Shan then made his way to the control center in order to bring down the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] of the facility thereby destroying it by exposing it to sun. Meanwhile Teff'ith and Zho made their way towards the hangar and engaged in a [[Lightfight|fire fight]] with Imperial forces to distract from Shan's goal. Teff'ith and Zho had made it to the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], however, Zho was killed by [[Imperial soldier|Imperial troopers]] when he pushed Teff'ith out of the line of fire. Meanwhile, Shan entered the control center and found Darth Mekhis there. After fighting with her Sith Knights and other [[Imperial soldier]]s and was seemingly captured by them, Shan drew Mekhis closer by revealing his name and claiming to be a Jedi. When Mekhis came closer, Shan shot her with a [[Poison/Legends|toxin]] from his arm. He then killed the other Imperials and lowered the shields of the facilities. Upon reaching his ship, Shan and Teff'ith escaped the explosion and destruction of the Sun Razer and the shipyard. Shan returned to Coruscant and reported to the Director of his activities. Though the Sun Razer and it's surrounding shipyard were destroyed, several of the warships created there were in operation in the Sith fleet and the Director felt that the Cold War was ready to heat up again into full conflict. Shan told the Director his intentions to keep investigating with a special interest in a [[Lightspeed/Legends|light-speed]] cannon that was capable of eliminating hyperspace targets called the [[Gauntlet (Sith Empire)|''Gauntlet'']].<ref name="TORTLS5" />

{{GameLSmechanics}}
====Ord Mantell operations====
{{Quote|We are with the Republic. We are the ones who watch spies. But she watches for the others--for the Empire. They have both eyes on Ord Mantell--her eyes.|Agent Ebenga explains his mission to Republic heroes|<ref name="Scavenger Hunt">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Scavenger Hunt|Ord Mantell}}</ref>}}
During the [[Separatist War]] on the Republic world [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], SIS agent [[Ebenga]] monitored a resident in [[Talloran village]] named [[Alma (Ord Mantell)|Alma]] whom he suspected of being an Imperial spy. An [[Takeover of Talloran village|attack]] on the village by [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|separatist forces]] forced Alma to flee her home and seek shelter at a refugee camp outside [[Fort Garnik]]. Ebenga subsequently entered Alma's abandoned home in search of an alleged heirloom necklace he believed was a disguised communication device used by Alma to transmit information to the Empire, but the necklace had already been stolen from the home by scavengers. When Republic heroes arrived at Alma's home seeking the necklace at her request, Ebenga revealed his suspicions and the location of the scavengers to them. The heroes raided the scavenger camp outside the village, defeating several scavengers <ref name="Preying on Thieves">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Preying on Thieves|Ord Mantell}}</ref> and recovering the necklace which they delivered to Ebenga who promised to use the evidence to secure Alma's arrest.<ref name="Scavenger Hunt" />

A few months prior, the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Veem Set]] approached the Republic offering information on the separatist movement for which the Republic offered him protection. Set was captured by the separatists before the Republic could ensure his safety. Before initiating an assault on the [[Separatist stronghold]], the Republic heroes were asked by SIS official [[Milo Phipps]] to release Set from captivity to fulfill the Republic's promise. The heroes assaulted the stronghold, defeating over fifty separatist fighters,<ref name="Weaken the Stronghold">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Weaken the Stronghold|Ord Mantell}}</ref> and released Set, who was retrieved outside the base by Phipps' agents. Set subsequently conveyed his information to the Republic who planned further assaults against the separatists.<ref name="Witness Protection">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Witness Protection|Ord Mantell}}</ref>

An hour prior to the heroes entering the separatist stronghold, the SIS was tipped off that the separatists were meeting with leaders of violent splinter groups across the Republic. Outside the stronghold, the heroes encountered SIS field agent [[Burne]] who asked them to access a computer terminal in the stronghold to ascertain the leaders' locations and defeat them and their bodyguards.<ref name="Alliance of Evil">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Alliance of Evil|Ord Mantell}}</ref>

====Coruscant operations====
{{Quote|Notice anything odd down here? Like how quickly the Justicars took control? Weapons and armor don't just materialize out of thin air. The Justicars have a supplier, and it isn't the Republic. You follow?|SIS agent Reid Gandon to Republic heroes|<ref name="A Diverting Assignment">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|A Diverting Assignment|Coruscant}}</ref>}}
Around this time, the SIS had been infiltrating agents into the [[Finaq Shipping Company]] on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world Coruscant for months to investigate contraband weapon shipments. The [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal group began hijacking the company's freighters, killing the crews and stealing the cargo, obstructing the investigation. SIS agent [[Nurls Yorksin]] recruited Republic heroes to locate the stolen freight in Black Sun [[Black Sun territory|territory]] and tag stolen shipments with tracking beacons so they could be recovered.<ref name="The Freightskippers">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|The Freightskippers|Coruscant}}</ref> While in the gang's territory, the heroes eliminated at least fifty-eight of their members<ref name="Stage1FF">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Stage 1 - Freightskipper Fracas|Coruscant}}</ref><ref name="Stage2FF">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Stage 2 - Freightskipper Fracas|Coruscant}}</ref> and three leaders<ref name="Stage3FF">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Stage 3 - Freightskipper Fracas|Coruscant}}</ref> and defeated gang member [[Teven Liss'ard]] and retrieved stolen shipping manifests to aid the SIS investigation.<ref name="StageFFF">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Final Stage - Freightskipper Fracas|Coruscant}}</ref>

After a [[Hologram disc/Legends|holodisc]] containing schematics for secret underground [[Coruscant secret underground tunnels|tunnels]] on the planet was stolen by the [[Justicars' Brigade]] militia, SIS agent [[Fieler Dan]] was assigned to track the thieves and locate the disc. She failed to report in to [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Forces]], prompting the recruitment of Republic heroes to locate her and the disc. The heroes found Dan in Justicar [[Justicar territory|territory]] and struck a deal to turn the disc over to her before returning it to Coruscant Security so [[Fieler Dan's daughter|her daughter]], head of a [[Undercity Assistance|local relief group]], could use the information for her own operations. The heroes retrieved the schematics from the Justicar's main computer while also defeating at least sixty of their members<ref name="Stage1JR">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Stage 1 - Justicar Resistance|Coruscant}}</ref><ref name="Stage2JR">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Stage 2 - Justicar Resistance|Coruscant}}</ref> including [[Jessa Bo'den]], from whom they retrieved access codes that had allowed the Justicars to access secure facilities.<ref name="StageFJR">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Final Stage - Justicar Resistance|Coruscant}}</ref> The heroes allowed Dan to make a copy of the disc before submitting it to the custody of local authorities.<ref name="Secret Passages">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Secret Passages|Coruscant}}</ref>

In the Justicars' territory, SIS agent [[Reid Gandon]] theorized that the Justicars were being supplied by the Sith Empire but required proof. He enlisted the aid of Republic heroes to retrieve three manifest data packets in the Justicars' [[Shipping Docks|shipping docks]] to help identify their supplier. The heroes defeated at least thirty Justicars in the docks<ref name="CutD">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Cleaning up the Docks|Coruscant}}</ref> and provided the data to Gandon who relayed them to his superiors.<ref name="A Diverting Assignment" />

=====Securing Secrets=====
{{Quote|Thirty-two hours ago, thieves raided a military storehouse. They stole weapons, supplies and data files for the Planet Prison project.|SIS agent Galen briefs Republic and Jedi officials|<ref name="The Jedi Envoy">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Jedi Envoy|Coruscant}}</ref>}}
[[File:Strategic_Command_meeting.png|thumb|left|250px|SIS agent Galen briefs Republic and Jedi officials on a local threat.]]
{{Main|Mission to Coruscant (Desolator crisis)}}
After a military storehouse was [[Raid on a Republic Military warehouse|raided]] by [[Thief/Legends|thieves]], SIS agent [[Galen (SIS)|Galen]] was tasked to pursue a lead to track the thieves and stolen encrypted design files for the [[Planet Prison]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]. Galen and his team identified the thieves' leader from surveillance cameras as a [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]] associate named [[Vistis Garn]] and directed a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] to the thieves' location to [[Raid on the Migrant Merchants' Guild warehouse|recover]] the files and other stolen items.<ref name="The Jedi Envoy" />

After the successful recovery of the stolen items, Galen informed the knight that Doctor Tarnis, the lead designer of the Planet Prison, had been [[Kidnapping of Doctor Tarnis|kidnapped]] and directed the knight to [[Skirmish in Docking Bay 84|attempt a rescue]] at the [[Coruscant Spaceport|nearby spaceport]].<ref name="Stolen Secrets">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Stolen Secrets|Coruscant}}</ref> Meanwhile, Galen's team discovered the stolen files contained information on multiple Republic superweapon research sites and he prepared to depart Coruscant to defend one of them. Before leaving, Galen put the knight in contact with a special Coruscant Security unit to aid in a [[Raid on the Black Sun headquarters|raid]] on Black Sun headquarters.<ref name="Kidnapped!">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Kidnapped!|Coruscant}}</ref>

====Nar Shaddaa operations====
{{Quote|Missions on Nar Shaddaa are usually green-lit by the SIS. With your permission, I'd like to meet with them, see what they know.|Havoc Squad member Aric Jorgan asks his commander for permission to inquire about his old unit|<ref name="MiA">{{TORcite|type=conversation|[[Aric Jorgan]]|Missing in Action}}</ref>}}
On the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]-controlled [[Moon/Legends|moon]] Nar Shaddaa, SIS agent [[Jatta Kuum]] attempted to dismantle the [[pit fighting]] business of local [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Kata]] the Hutt in the moon's [[Nikto Sector]] before the operation became too dangerous and he fell under surveillance by the Hutt's forces. Kuum sought to end the pit fights because the profits generated from them were used by Kata to fund various separatist movements within the Republic which threatened to spark multiple mini-wars and degrade the Republic's ability to confront the Imperial threat. Kuum later secured the assistance of Republic heroes who defeated at least ten of Kata's arena fighters as well as the pit fighting champion and used explosives to destroy Kata's vault containing all the critical information needed to keep the pit fights operational. Kuum assessed the strike as having delivered a huge blow to separatist efforts and resolved to infiltrate the movement to dismantle it from the inside.<ref name="Blood Money" />

The SIS emplaced a [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] in the moon's [[Corellian Sector (Nar Shaddaa)/Legends|Corellian Sector]] to monitor Imperial transmissions. To conceal this post's presence, the SIS relayed stolen reports to local Krayt gang [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] who offered to sell the reports on the black market.<ref name="The Walls Have Ears">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|The Walls Have Ears|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref> After a local [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] named [[Ghost (Neimoidian)|Ghost]] revealed to Imperial heroes that the gang had sliced into Imperial databases and stolen several sensitive reports, the heroes recovered the reports and delivered them to Imperial Intelligence [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Keeling]]<ref name="Let the Vendor Beware">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Let the Vendor Beware|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref> while defeating at least fifteen members of the gang.<ref name="Slicing Through the Krayts">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Slicing through the Krayts|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref> Keeling discovered the reports bore SIS slicing signatures along with coordinates to the their listening post and dispatched the heroes to destroy the post's comm terminal.<ref name="The Walls Have Ears" /> At least ten SIS personnel were defeated in the attack on the listening post.<ref name="Silence in the Listening Post">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Silence in the Listening Post|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>

In the [[Upper Industrial Sector]]'s [[Lenstrum Market]], SIS operatives were making a deal with local [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealers]] to purchase experimental [[Armor/Legends|armor]] designs when they were attacked and defeated by Imperial heroes. The heroes were recruited by the Imperial [[Factor Jarvus]] to defeat the gangsters and SIS agents and recover the armor plans.<ref name="Bidding War">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Bidding War|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref> To dissuade further such dealings with the Republic, the heroes defeated at least ten arms dealers.<ref name="No Deal">{{TORcite|type=bonus|No Deal|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>

In the nearby [[Lower Industrial Sector]]'s [[Labor District]], SIS agent [[Kalda Biss]] was sent by local resistance leader [[Ganuk]] to investigate claims the Empire was producing toxins to kill specific [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] at a nearby chemical plant, but fell out of contact.<ref name="Genocide">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Genocide|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref> Ganuk later arranged for Republic heroes to install a scanner into a mainframe at [[Pharmalux Technologies]], one of the Empire's front companies, revealing that the Empire was producing chemicals to kill all the [[Evocii]] on Nar Shaddaa.<ref name="Chemical Agent">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Chemical Agent|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref> While assaulting the [[Pharmalux Waste Processing facility]] to halt the alien genocide, the heroes freed Biss from Imperial captivity. Biss directed the heroes to stop Imperial commander [[Vergost]]'s extermination program and eliminate additional Imperial leaders in the facility while she secured additional Republic support. The heroes defeated at least ten Imperial wardens and captains<ref name="Exterminate the Wardens">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Bad Chemistry|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref> before finally taking Vergost into custody.<ref name="Extermination">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Extermination|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>

=====Infiltrating Shadow Town=====
{{Quote|This is Shadow Town, a prison city filled with the Empire's worst assassins and madmen, kept on ice 'til Papa Sith needs them.|SIS Agent Zan Loren briefs Republic heroes on Shadow Town|<ref name="Those Left Behind">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Those Left Behind|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>}}
SIS agents [[Alys]] and [[Kesler]] were gathering information about the [[Nar Shaddaa Labor Alliance|Labor Alliance's]] dealings with the Empire when Kesler's cover was blown. Kesler was subsequently imprisoned in [[Shadow Town]], a slum used by the Empire as a prison to house individuals of potential use,<ref name="Shadow Town">{{TORcite|type=codex|Shadow Town}}</ref> before he could transmit his report which the SIS needed to ensure the success of an upcoming sting operation. Two weeks after Kesler's imprisonment, Alys asked Republic heroes to make contact with Kesler in Shadow Town's [[Forced Retirement Home]] to obtain the report. Upon finding Kesler, he revealed that he hid his report on a modified [[Credit chip/Legends|cred stick]] which the heroes recovered from one of the Imperial prison provosts and Kesler decrypted before the heroes delivered it to Alys.<ref name="A Tough Sell">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|A Tough Sell|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>

Around this time, the SIS discovered the Empire was upgrading the cranial bombs implanted into Shadow Town prisoners that prevented them from escaping. Identifying this rare opportunity, the SIS initiated an ultraviolet-level mission seeking support to capture the schematics for the explosives technology so Republic scientists could discern a way to disable the cranial bombs and allow the SIS to extract prisoners from Shadow Town. The four Republic heroes raided Shadow Town's prison control center and downloaded the schematics and destroyed several research computers<ref name="Breaking Down Shadow Town">{{TORcite|type=heroic|Breaking Down Shadow Town|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref> while defeating at least twenty-five Imperials.<ref name="Broken Imperials">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Broken Imperials|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>

======Rescuing a Jedi======
{{Quote|The Empire holds prisoners of war, our men, in the worst of this whole mess--Camp 27. We know they're holding Ako Domi here, one of the Jedi heroes of the Battle of Sullust, and we want him back.|Agent Zan Loren briefs Republic heroes on the SIS rescue operation in Shadow Town|<ref name="Those Left Behind" />}}
Also at this time, SIS agent [[Zan Loren]], who'd been stationed on the moon for six years, was coordinating the SIS effort to secure the release of the Jedi [[Ako Domi]] and other Republic prisoners from Shadow Town. To begin the operation, Loren tasked the Republic heroes with obtaining access codes to [[Camp 27]], where the Empire held Republic prisoners of war, from prison wardens when they came outside the prison's shields.<ref name="Those Left Behind" />

Because Shadow Town's security access code was divided into parts and changed every few minutes, the heroes first retrieved the primary, security, and subsystem access codes from Imperial prison wardens and returned them to Loren before they could be changed.<ref name="Access">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Access|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref> To facilitate their upcoming assault on Camp 27, the heroes defeated at least fifteen prison guards while retrieving the codes.<ref name="Street Sweeper">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Street Sweeper|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>

Upon entering Camp 27, the heroes opened four cell blocks, releasing the Republic POWs contained within, and defeated at least another fifteen guards.<ref name="Jailbreak">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Jailbreak|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref> While questioning an Imperial interrogator about Ako Domi's whereabouts, the interrogator summoned Domi, who was revealed to have fallen to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Domi and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentices]] attacked the heroes but were defeated. SIS agents arrived and took Domi into custody to be transferred to the care of a [[Jedi healer/Legends|Jedi healer]] and seized the camp's records.<ref name="Captive">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Captive|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>

=====Power Guard Project=====
{{Quote|Wish I had better news to report. We're fumbling in the dark right now.|Bureau Chief Rieekan|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
{{Main|Mission to Nar Shaddaa (Desolator crisis)}}
On [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], the SIS established a sizable covert operation. Led by Bureau Chief [[Rieekan (SIS)|Rieekan]], agents tracked Imperial and [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] movements on the planet. When personnel from a program designed to create super-soldiers called the [[Power Guard Enhancement System|Power Guard Project]] went missing, including Agent Galen, the SIS immediately began investigating assisted by a Jedi Knight.<ref name="SWTORPowerGuard">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Power Guard Project|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref> The Jedi Knight found out at the [[SIS safe house|SIS headquarters]] that Agent Galen should have been at the [[Power Guard recruitment center]]. Upon the Knights arrival, the Knight found that Imperials had raided the recruitment center. [[Vell Narroc]], an SIS Power Guard recruiter, informed that Knight that Galen had been captured and taken by the Sith to the [[Power Guard Cybernetics Lab]].<ref name="SWTORsfg" /> There the knight was able to track down Galen's whereabouts and also discovered that the Sith had taken over the Power Guard project.<ref name="SWTORredblack">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Red Light, Black Heart|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>

[[File:Sissafehouse.png|thumb|right|250px|SIS headquarters on Nar Shaddaa]]
Returning to the SIS safe house, the Jedi Knight found that Imperial forces had raided the place, killing several agents including Chief Rieekan. Special Agent [[Korol Tander|Tander]] took over as acting Bureau Chief. The Jedi Knight headed off to Shadow Town to retrieve Galen and take down Lord [[Sadic]], the Sith commander who was behind the Empire's operations.<ref name="SWTORstrike">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Striking Back|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref> Beginning at the [[Strategic Information Service base (Nar Shaddaa)|SIS base]] outside of [[Shadow Town]], a Imperial prison camp, the Knight fought to where Galen was located. However, Galen had been turned into a Power Guard cyborg and was slaved to the commands of Sadic through pain infliction. After fighting the Knight, Galen fled to Sadic's lab and attacked the Sith only to be defeated and severely wounded. The Knight also went to Sadic's lab but was able to kill him. Special Agent Tander along with Agent [[Diyaz]] and commandos from [[Blackstar Squad|Black Star Squad]] destroyed the Power Guard files as well as Sadic's lab and any equipment associated with the project. Agent Galen, freed from his enslavement, was given a special assignment by the SIS where his unique cyborg powers would be needed.<ref name="SWTORsadicshow">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Showdown with Lord Sadic|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>

=====Hunting Traitors=====
{{Quote|This war droid's rampage must be stopped before it's linked with the Republic. An agent of the Strategic Information Service will be assisting you. Officially, you're providing military support to an SIS operation. Do not divulge Tavus's defection, or the droid's connection to it.|Republic Special Forces commander General Elin Garza briefs the commander of Havoc Squad on a mission on Nar Shaddaa|<ref name="A New Player">{{TORcite|type=class|Republic Trooper|A New Player|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref>}}
A separate SIS team led by agent [[Jonas Balkar]] was involved in an operation to stop the rampage of a Republic [[Battle droid/Legends|war droid]], [[M1-4X]], across the moon. Initially unknown to the SIS, the droid's attacks were tied to the [[SpecForce Incident|defections]] of multiple [[Republic Special Forces Division]] personnel. The SIS operation was assisted by SpecForce's [[Havoc Squad]].<ref name="A New Player" /> By the time Havoc Squad arrived on the moon, Balkar's team had identified a pattern in the droid's attacks. They noted that a group of paramilitary-looking personnel arrived at each attack site prior to the droid. The team observed the paramilitary figures at [[Axxon Storage and Reclamation]]'s vault in the moon's [[Nikto Sector]] and directed Havoc Squad there to attempt to capture the droid.<ref name="The Republic's Finest">{{TORcite|type=class|Republic Trooper|The Republic's Finest|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref>

After encountering M1-4X and the Republic defectors in the vault but failing to apprehend the droid, Balkar directed Havoc Squad to the moon's [[Red Light Sector (Nar Shaddaa)|Red Light Sector]] where they conducted an assault on the defector's [[Marpessa Munitions|base]] hoping to trigger a call for aid that could be traced to their Imperial handlers. The mission was a success and Balkar's team traced the call to a penthouse in the [[Club Vertica Casino]]. To gain access to the penthouse, Balkar directed Havoc to a substation in the [[Lower Industrial Sector]] with SIS slicer [[Niall Piv]] to slice the casino's security system and add the Havoc members to the penthouse's access list.<ref name="Reaching Out">{{TORcite|type=class|Republic Trooper|Reaching Out|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref> After successfully protecting Piv while he added the soldiers to the list, Havoc proceeded to the casino penthouse where they confronted Imperial [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Zardres]] and the agents behind M1-4X's attacks and learned from them of M1-4X and the traitor's whereabouts in Shadow Town.<ref name="Climbing the Ladder">{{TORcite|type=class|Republic Trooper|Climbing the Ladder|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref> Proceeding to the [[droid charging facility]] in Shadow Town where the defectors were attempting to supercharge M1-4X's [[M1-4X's power core|power core]], Havoc Squad defeated the defectors and the droid while an SIS technician team moved into the facility to collect evidence.<ref name="Overloaded">{{TORcite|type=class|Republic Trooper|Overloaded|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref>

=====Thwarting Imperial Mercenaries=====
{{Quote|SIS reconnaissance located an enemy industrial complex swarming with heavily armed mercenaries. If that army is unleashed on us, we're done.|Senate Liaison Deera Ulyette explains a threat on Nar Shaddaa to Republic heroes|<ref name="TRtW">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|The Road to War|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref>}}
The [[3642 BBY|following year]],<ref name="3642BBY">{{TOR_dates|2}}</ref> Republic-aligned Hutt crime boss [[Bareesh Fenn'ak Torill]] alerted the Republic that the Empire was training a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] force on the moon to attack Republic civilians and operating a vicious [[Imperial Re-education Center|interrogation center]]. Working from Bareesh's information, the SIS confirmed the location of the mercenary [[Staging area/Legends|staging area]] and the Republic heroes were recruited to return to Nar Shaddaa and confront this threat.<ref name="TRtW" /> Proceeding to the Worker's Quarters in the Imperial Intelligence Gadget Warehouse the heroes met with [[IK-4C]], a reprogrammed Imperial [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] used by SIS agent [[Trace (SIS)|Trace]] to establish contact with the heroes while he infiltrated Imperial Intelligence headquarters. Trace had been successfully coordinating with a local resistance cell in the area and instructed the heroes to aid the cell's members in shutting down the interrogation center and can confronting the mercenaries.<ref name="TWfNS">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|The War for Nar Shaddaa|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref>

The heroes took on a mission from former Imperial worker [[Uli Zhensi]] to destroy equipment terminals and defeat the Imperial archon supervising the interrogation center.<ref name="AoI">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Art of Interrogation|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref> Simultaneously, the heroes were directed by resistance leader [[Ciqala]] to recover useful equipment from the mercenary [[Mercenary training facility|training camp]] to better arm the rebellion against the Empire.<ref name="OPaaT">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|One Piece at a Time|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref>

While in the Imperial warehouse, the heroes undertook a separate mission from SIS agent [[Mas Avaho]] to destroy an Imperial prototype device that would have given the Empire the ability to slice Republic communications from any distance. The heroes defeated at least fifteen Imperial warehouse personnel<ref name="PI">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Passing Inspection|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref> and three Sith apprentices dispatched by their master to retrieve the device.<ref name="Inspection">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Inspection|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref>

Having successfully thwarted the Empire's plan to launch a surprise attack, the Empire began preparing to execute several Republic POWs, SIS agents who previously infiltrated an annex of the notorious Shadow Town, in retaliation. Suspecting his cover had been blown, agent Trace prepared to escape Nar Shaddaa while directing the heroes to deliver a supply of [[Detonite/Legends|detonite]] to reprogrammed [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T6-B9]] and SIS agent [[Valland]] in [[High Security Lockdown]] and assist other SIS operatives there. Valland desired to use the detonite to strike the Empire in retaliation for the destruction of SIS headquarters but was persuaded by the heroes to initiate diversionary strikes to cause chaos while they assisted other agents.<ref name="TWfNS" />

SIS agent [[Jaysa Wise]] had been deployed to Shadow Town with half-a-dozen other agents for the previous year but urgently needed to evacuate due to the capture of her colleague [[Karhel]] by the Imperials. The heroes eliminated at least fifteen Imperial riot guards<ref name="Riot!">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Riot!|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref> and released three insane Sith prisoners, one of which went on to release a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] in the annex, to occupy the prison guards so the SIS agents could escape.<ref name="Diversion">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Diversion|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref> Lastly, the heroes pursued rogue SIS astromech droid [[TC-93]] at the behest of its creator, [[Carina]], as the droid possessed top secret SIS information in its memory. The heroes permitted the droid to selectively delete the sensitive intel from its memory to preserve its developing sentience.<ref name="MF">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Memory Flush|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref>

====Tatooine operation====
{{Main|SIS operation on Tatooine}}
{{Quote|This is a Republic Strategic Information Service project--a covert operation. It's a major assignment. Mystery, corporate scandal and incredibly dangerous tech--with a lot of lives on the line.|Agent Fauler reveals SIS activity to Republic heroes on Tatooine|<ref name="TA">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Timely Arrival|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>}}

Around this time, [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] [[Accountant/Legends|accountant]] [[Kamus Orden]] forwarded documents to Republic security officials detailing an expensive and deadly Czerka research project. SIS agent [[Fauler]] and Orden traveled to the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] planet Tatooine in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] to uncover the mysterious Czerka doomsday device and prevent the company from concealing its existence. With leads to discovering the device running dry, Fauler recruited a skilled Republic spacer to investigate an abandoned Czerka [[Jundland Czerka facility|compound]] in [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] and search its archives for clues. Fauler's associate found Czerka's compound overrun by [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] who made a deal with Czerka enforcer [[Gayem Leksende]] to return the information to the company. The spacer defeated the Gamorreans and delivered the data to Fauler and Orden to review.<ref name="TA" /> In the files, Orden discovered a former Czerka security officer assigned to the research facility before its abandonment decades prior, [[Grommik Kurthson]], was still living on the planet. Fauler dispatched the spacer to meet Kurthson to discern the location of the Czerka base and nature of the doomsday weapon. The spacer rescued Kurthson from an attack by Gayem's forces and the retired security officer provided them with additional files on Czerka's past activities on the planet.<ref name="LOO">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Last One Out|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

From the new files, Fauler determined the approximate location of Czerka's base but required additional information to account for the sand shift over the previous decades. To that end, Fauler dispatched the spacer to take geological readings. From the data, Fauler detected a nearby energy signature and the spacer went to investigate, discovering it originated from a transmitter in a Czerka [[Czerka listening outpost|listening outpost]], which they destroyed.<ref name="FT">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Field Trip|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> After discovering the location of the Czerka base in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] and collecting access codes to the base from several Czerka relay towers in the desert, the spacer lead a strike into the base, where they found that the weapon in question was actually a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Mind prison|mind prison]] housing the intelligence of an [[The Imprisoned One|ancient Rakatan]]. The spacer defeated an attempted ambush by the Rakata and killed Gayem Leksende who followed them into the base, after which atempted to destroy the mind prison.<ref name="TTCF">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|The Thing Czerka Found|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> Following Czerka's defeat, Fauler took Kamus to Coruscant, to testify against the crimes of the Corporation.<ref name="kamus mail">{{TORcite|type=message|Life after Czerka!|Kamus Orden}}</ref>

====Syvris system operation====
The SIS operated a clandestine listening post in the [[Syvris system/Legends|Syvris system]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] that was discovered by Imperial forces. The Empire accused the installation of violating the Treaty of Coruscant and deployed naval forces to seize and destroy the intelligence stored there. Though the Republic installation initiated an evacuation of the facility, the Empire pursued its attack and the SIS sustained some casualties.<ref name="SE">{{TORcite|type=space|Syvris Evacuation}}</ref>

At the behest of [[Republic Fleet Command/Legends|Republic Fleet Command]], the newly formed attack [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] [[Coruscant Aegis]] rallied in the system to defend the SIS evacuation. In the ensuing [[Battle of the Syvris system|battle]], the squadron defended fleeing SIS personnel preserving the gathered intelligence from attacking Imperial forces.<ref name="SE" />

====Other actions====
{{Quote|Have to hand it to the SIS. Nobody does "nondescript" quite like them.|Jedi Kira Carsen|<ref name="TOR" />}}
On [[Voss]], an up and coming Sith named [[Durik Vesh]] went into the [[Nightmare Lands]] seeking the source of the dark side energy there. During his travel, Vesh became mad before being captured by Republic forces and taken to a [[Strategic Information Service camp|SIS camp]] on the planet. There interrogators attempted to extract information on the Empire and the Nightmare Lands from Vesh's addled brain. The SIS eventually decided to move him to a different location. [[Darth Serevin]] discovered the intentions of the SIS and sent the Sith Lord [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] to ambush the convoy and kill Vesh, preventing him from revealing any more information to the SIS.<ref name="TakeBait">
{{TORcite|class=class|Sith Inquisitor|Taking the Bait|Voss}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

===Galactic War===
====Operation End Game====
{{Main|Operation End Game}}
The ''[[Ascendant Spear]]'', a [[Terminus-class destroyer|''Terminus''-class destroyer]] by design, began to be modified into a long-range battle cruiser near the end of the Cold War. With enhanced hyperdrive capabilities and a devastating megalaser primary weapon, the ''Ascendant Spear'' was considered by many to be an Imperial [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]. It would be commanded&mdash;''directly''&mdash;by [[Darth Karrid]] through a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] interface.<ref name="Annihilation" />

The Republic had become aware of the ship several years earlier, when a covert SIS operation had uncovered its existence in the [[Vesla system/Legends|Vesla system]]. Eventually, the understanding of the threat coalesced into a [[Mission to Ziost|mission to Imperial space]] in which SIS agent Theron Shan teamed with Jedi Master [[Gnost-Dural]] to steal a [[black cipher]] encryption device from the Empire in order to track the ship's movements. The functionality of the encryption device was proven when the SIS learned of an impending imperial [[Battle of Ruan|attack]] on the Republic [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] [[Ruan]]. But, in order to protect the knowledge that the Republic possessed the cipher device, [[Supreme Commander]] [[Jace Malcom]] was unable to send any military assistance to aid the doomed world. The Imperial forces attacked, killing thousands and destroying Ruan's agricultural production capabilities.<ref name="Annihilation" />

Karrid began selection of her next target, while Republic forced hurriedly arranged for a trap to be laid. Through the actions of Republic covert intelligence, Darth Karrid was lured into [[Battle of Duro (Galactic War)|attacking]] the Republic [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] at the planet [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. The ambush was a success. The Republic forces under Supreme Commander Malcom were able to engage and destroy the fleet commanded by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Nezzor]], which in turned allowed Agent Shan and Master Gnost-Dural to infiltrate the ''Ascendant Spear'' itself. The pair were able to defeat Karrid, and the Imperial superweapon was destroyed.<ref name="Annihilation" />

====Revanite crisis====
Theron Shan helped plan the [[Korriban Incursion]] in [[3637 BBY]] in order to retrieve strategic data to turn the tide of the war. After the [[Assault on Tython]], which coincided with their assault on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], Theron became suspicious of a conspiracy involving [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Rian Darok]] and [[Darth Arkous]]. Theron spied on Darok and updated a Republic ally on his suspicious behavior, noting that he didn't turn over the intelligence to the SIS.<ref name="Assault Republic">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=tactical|Korriban Incursion: Empire}}</ref>

[[File:Jakarro_and_Theron_Shan_on_Rakata_Prime.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Jakarro and Theron Shan on Rakata Prime]]
Theron later came into contact with [[Lana Beniko]], Arkous' adviser, who too suspected that her superior was up to no good. They determined that the attacks were smash-and-grabs meant to recover Rakata technology. They dispatched a strike team to [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]], where they besieged an underwater base where Arkous and Darok were creating invincible cyborg supersoldiers. However, the two conspirators managed to escape with their research and scuttled the base, leaving the team to die. Theron managed to help the strike team escape before the base reached crush depth. Once they rendezvoused with Lana, the Sith revealed that Arkous and Darok were members of the [[Order of Revan]]. They then joined by [[Jakarro]], a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] smuggler who was imprisoned by the Revanites after delivering their medical supplies, wanting revenge against the two men. Theron agreed to work with him to track down the Revanites.

After aiding the pursuers in tracking down Arkous and Darok to [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]] (then called "Rakata Prime"), Theron had hoped for the capture of the two Revanite leaders to learn more of their plans; however, both refused to submit and were killed as a result. It was then that the real Revanite leader was revealed to be none other than Revan himself. Escaping from Rakata Prime, Theron met with Lana, Jakarro, and their allies one last time on Manaan, where he revealed that he was classified as a "disavowed rogue agent, apprehend on sight" (as opposed to the others, who received death sentences - twelve, in Jakarro's case), believing that Director Trant had managed to grant him the "lesser" punishment. However, in order to avoid being located by the Revanites, he, Lana and Jakarro were forced to go into hiding, leaving their allies to deal with hunting down Revan and his followers.<ref name="FAIII">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|Forged Alliances: Part III|Manaan}}</ref>

===Later history===
Eventually, the SIS was replaced by the [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|Senate Bureau of Intelligence]] as the primary espionage agency for the Galactic Senate.<ref name="Intelreform" />

==Notable members==
[[File:RSISdirector.png|thumb|right|120px|The Director]]

===Marcus Trant===
{{Quote|I've got an agency stretched thin, a bounty on my head, and an ex-wife under Senate investigation&mdash;I don't need more worries.|Marcus Trant|<ref name="TORTLS1" />}}
{{Main|Marcus Trant}}
The Director had served in the SIS since its early years when it was a branch of the Senate Library. By the time the war ended, he had climbed through the ranks and attained the position of Director. Along the way he made sacrifices in his personal life when his marriage fell apart, and in public where he had to contend with a thinly stretched agency and bounty that had been placed on his head. However, he realized his role to be vital. To him the Senate and the Jedi Order were age old institutions that hated change and so a flexible organization was needed to protect the Republic, a role the Director felt the SIS filled and so deserved his loyalty.<ref name="TORTLS1" />

===Theron Shan===
{{Quote|I have a standing invitation to spend time with the skyraiders of Thonboka. I may take them up on it&mdash;I've never flown in a saddle, and Coruscant is getting stale...''"<br />"''Dont give me that ''leave of absence'' garbage.|Theron Shan and the Director|<ref name="TORTLS1" />}}
[[File:Agent_Theron_Shan.jpg|thumb|right|120px|Theron Shan]]
{{Main|Theron Shan}}
Theron Shan was an agent for the SIS during the Cold War in the years following the Treaty of Coruscant. Shan was good at his work, though his attitude was one of both sarcasm and, to a certain degree, resentfulness of his abilities as a spy and the life he led. Shan was also the secret son of [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] and was raised by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Ngani Zho. Shan continued in some of the Jedi traditions by meditating and fasting in the morning before he gave up the latter habit. While investigating the Black Sun crime syndicate for possibly selling slaves to the Sith Empire, Shan captured a female Twi'lek named Teff'ith who was involved in the deal. In a move that expressed his own brand of humor, Shan did not turn her over to [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security]] instead opting to take her, bound and chained, on his newly assigned mission to find Ngani Zho. He later developed a tentative working relationship with her and released her after the mission. Shan was also accompanied on his mission by his droid, [[M-6]].<ref name="TORTLS1" />

===Galen===
{{Quote|Doctor Tarnis is the least of our worries, General.|Galen, in reference to several security breaches|<ref name="TOR" />}}
[[File:Galen.png|thumb|right|120px|Galen]]
{{Main|Galen (SIS)}}
Galen served as an agent for the SIS during the Cold War. In [[3643 BBY]] he was called in along with agents of the Coruscant Security Force to investigate the theft of several plans of the [[Planet Prison]] superweapon. Galen discovered the location of the thief in Migrant Merchants' Guild territory. With the assistance of the Jedi, the plans were recovered.<ref name="SWTORStolensecrets">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Stolen Secrets|Coruscant}}</ref> However, with the Doctor Tarnis missing along with the Planet Prison, Galen's task became more difficult. Galen sent the Jedi and CSF agents to rescue Tarnis from the Black Sun kidnappers at the Coruscant Spaceport. While there they found that it was a distraction and that Tarnis was really deep in Black Sun territory.<ref name="SWTORKidnapped">{{TORcite|type=class|Kidnapped|Coruscant}}</ref> Galen then offered the assistance of the CSF Special Tactical Unit to rescue Tarnis. Galen himself went to secure other vital Republic stations. The Jedi, along with the Tactical Unit, were able to locate the supposed hideout only to find that Tarnis was in fact a Sith Lord.<ref name="SWTORRescue">{{TORcite|type=Jedi Knight|The Rescue|Coruscant}}</ref> Afterwards, Galen headed to Nar Shaddaa to secure the Power Guard Project. There he was captured by the Sith operatives and turned into a power guard soldier himself, slaved to the commands of Sith Lord Sadic.<ref name="SWTORsfg" /> Galen fought back but was defeated and severely injured. He later went on to be planted by the SIS behind enemy lines.<ref name="SWTORsadicshow" />

==Behind the scenes==
The SIS was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] (MMORPG) by [[BioWare]] released on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. The organization is not playable, but is featured heavily in various class stories. The SIS also took a lead role in the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic — The Lost Suns|''Star Wars: The Old Republic—The Lost Suns'']] comic book series which began publication in [[June]] [[2011]].<ref name="Freed1" />

Though the SWTOR website [[Timeline 2: The Mandalorian Blockade is Broken|Timeline 2]] online video refers to it as Republic Strategic Information Systems, ''The Old Republic'' developer and writer of ''The Lost Suns'' comics [[Alexander Freed]] confirmed its official name as the Republic Strategic Information Service and it has appeared under that name in following publications.<ref name="Freed1" />
